This plot is only 0.14 hectares, so one full bag of DAP or urea from the cooperative would be far too much and I do not have the cash to buy it anyway this season. I will spread whatever cow manure I have saved on this field instead, and I will plant the same local seed I kept from last year because it still grows well enough. It is a small piece of land, so my wife and I can manage all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without hiring anyone.
